Ethan: Hey people-ops — quick Q: can folks carry over unused PTO into next year? Team's planning around the late-year launch.
Maya (People Ops): Short answer: yes, up to 40 hours (5 days) can be carried into the next calendar year without special approval. Anything above that is "use it or lose it" unless you get manager + People Ops signoff for a one-time exception.
Priya: Does sick time or bereavement count toward that 40h carryover?
Maya (People Ops): Sick time is handled separately and does NOT count toward the PTO carryover cap. Bereavement/comp time are separate buckets too. Note: accruals and sick carryover can vary by state/country — if you’re outside the US ping me.
Ethan: Cool — what are the accrual rates so I can tell the team?
Sam (Payroll): Accruals (US employees): `0–12 months: 80h/year (3.08h/pay)`, `1–3 years: 120h/year (4.62h/pay)`, `3+ years: 160h/year (6.15h/pay)`. Accruals post on each pay period. Full table on the policy page: https://redwoodintranet/hr/pto-policy
Maya (People Ops): Process notes: to carry over hours employees must submit a "Carryover Request" in the Time Off section of the HRIS by Jan 15. Managers should approve in the system; People Ops will review any exceptions. We auto-zero PTO balances to the allowed cap on Jan 20 unless an approved request exists.
Timekeeper Bot: Reminder: PTO balances snapshot taken 2024-12-31 23:59 UTC for carryover calculations.
Priya: Any blackout dates we should flag now for planning around the launch?
Maya (People Ops): Yes — week of Dec 9–16 is a soft blackout for core infra/product teams due to the release. We expect rotational coverage; managers can approve critical exceptions but please coordinate early. Company holidays (listed in the policy) are already protected.
Ethan: If someone needs to take time off but is negative on balance (emergency), is there latitude?
Maya (People Ops): Managers can approve negative balances up to 40 hours for emergencies; People Ops signoff required. Negative balances must be reconciled by the end of Q1 next year (either via accruals or unpaid deduction). For extended leaves we route to Leave of Absence and Payroll.
Priya: Thanks — I'll tell the team to submit carryover requests by Jan 15 and flag any launch week conflicts now.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks all — quick checklist: 1) Submit Carryover Request in HRIS by Jan 15; 2) Managers approve in HRIS; 3) People Ops reviews exceptions; 4) Check blackout dates with your manager for launch coverage. Ping me or @sam if anything urgent. :handshake:
